prompt: Create an original 150 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 104 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A melancholic and dramatic orchestral piece featuring piano and strings, building from a gentle opening to a powerful, emotional climax before fading out.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有戏剧性的管弦乐作品，以钢琴和弦乐为主，从柔和的开场逐渐发展到高潮，然后逐渐淡出。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
